g.text: M4 - Level 1 Refinement of F3 Behaviour Planning (AEB branch)

g.id: cluster_F3 Behaviour Planning (Level-1 refinement of the AEB branch)
g.text: F3 Behaviour Planning (Level-1 refinement of the AEB branch)
"pre: risk_level <> '' and ego_state <> null and driver_intent <> null"
"post: driver_accel_request = 'true' and risk_level = 'critical' | required_decel_ms2 >= 6.0 and target_speed_kmh = 0.0"
"post: driver_accel_request = 'true' and risk_level <> 'critical' | manoeuvre_type <> 'emergency_deceleration' and required_decel_ms2 >= 0.0"
Only F3 is decomposed (R-SCOPE-4). All other Level-0 elements are shown as
N-1 (130 km/h), N-2 (2.0 s) - no value outside spec section 7 / 8 is used.
C-L1-1: considered_object_count >= 0 (nat) - the empty-set case reports count 0.
define a sentinel value for "no TTC" (see OI-12).
C-L1-2: F2 keeps the exclusive right to compute TTC (spec F2), yet section 6
assigns a TTC computation to F3.1 - conflict recorded as OI-6.
Warning is raised for caution and critical, not for no risk (spec F3.2).
C-L1-7: risk_level = 'no_risk' | manoeuvre_type = 'cruise' (and, as a second guarded line, manoeuvre_type = 'keep_lane')
-- the disjunction {cruise, keep_lane} is expressed as two guarded lines
because 'or' is not part of the permitted operator set.
| required_decel_ms2 >= 6.0 and target_speed_kmh = 0.0 (emergency is not overridden)
